referenceSources.title: AJ - Mazda RX-7 en compétition
referenceSources.description:
A striking blue and red Mazda RX-7 FD, tuned by RE Amemiya, powers through a corner on a Japanese racetrack. The car’s livery features bold sponsor logos—Dunlop, Bomex, Endless—and the number 7 on its door. A large rear wing and wide racing slicks underscore its GT300 specification in the Super GT series.

RE Amemiya, founded by Isami Amemiya in 1974, built its reputation on rotary engine tuning. The team entered the JGTC in 1995 with a 13B birotor engine and later upgraded to a 20B three-rotor unit producing 300 horsepower. After winning the GT300 championship in 2006, the RX-7 remained competitive until 2010, marking a significant chapter in Japan’s premier touring car series.
